slots.subtitle: Nothing overlaps, nothing duplicates, and every one of them earns the tab it occupies.

slots.toolTagline: If it is not on the board it is not happening, and nothing sits there longer than a week.
One database with three views, because four private lists is how work quietly goes missing.
The blank page is the expensive part. A rough version changes what you are willing to start.
Two people on the same frame settle in ten minutes what a thread would not settle in three days.
Checked once a day. Everything else moves too slowly to be worth watching more often.
The one that earns its place least. Kept because clients are there, not because it helps.

slots.body: A tool you opened twice this month is a subscription, not a system. Sort by what you actually touched.
